sections.heading: Serving Phoenix and the surrounding valley.
sections.body:
We cover all of Phoenix and the surrounding area, including Downtown, Arcadia, Encanto, and Maryvale. For fifteen years we have fitted glide-out shelves into valley kitchens, measuring the cabinet you already own and building to that exact opening.

Every shelf is measured in your home and cut to that opening, so an older Phoenix kitchen gets the same fit as a new build. Postcodes served include 85004, 85006, 85008, and 85012.
